notes: Route: kanal5.com.mk/robots.txt (200, Disallow: empty = permissive) advertises Sitemap: https://kanal5.com.mk/sitemap.aspx. Self-test: 4 sample articles re-fetched, all HTTP 200 with 12.7k-15.7k visible chars and page date exactly equal to the listed date. Gotchas: www.kanal5.com.mk returns Cloudflare 525 (site unreachable via www) - use the apex domain; article pages have no JSON-LD/meta dates, the printed 'Објавил: <d> <month> <y>, HH:MM' is the date source.
